sloka: शिरसा मे शिरसः च अस्य कायम् कायेन योजय ।रावण अनुगमिष्यामि गतिम् भर्तुर् महात्मनः ।। ६-३२-३२।।
transliteration: śirasā me śirasaḥ ca asya kāyam kāyena yojaya ।rāvaṇa anugamiṣyāmi gatim bhartur mahātmanaḥ ।। 6-32-32।।

translations.english: "O Ravana! Join my head with his and my body with his body. I will follow him in the same way."
